params.prompt: Vocabulary review task screen 'Kelime tekrarı · 3 / 8' with a thin yellow progress bar at top and a close button. A large rounded image card showing an illustrated old green radio on a desk. Prompt 'Hangisi "telsiz"?' . Four large white pill option buttons stacked: 'radio', 'river', 'rain', 'road'. Below, a sea-blue outlined pill button with a question icon 'Bilmiyorum'. Calm, encouraging, no timer. High-fidelity mobile app UI mockup, single iPhone screen, portrait, flat front view, no device frame, for 'hiVelzon', an English-learning app built around an animated coastal mystery story. Design system: warm sand background (#F7F1E6), white rounded cards (12px corners) with soft warm shadows, deep sea blue (#1F4E79) for titles and accents, lighthouse yellow (#F2B33D) pill-shaped primary buttons, evening orange (#E98A3C) small accents, small caps orange labels, rounded friendly bold headings (Nunito style) and clean body text (Inter style), 8px grid, generous whitespace, playful but calm, illustrated graphic-novel art inside shaped headers (wave or diagonal cut). Bottom navigation with 5 tabs: 'Ana Sayfa', 'Keşfet', 'Hikâye', 'Konuş', 'Profil', and a small round glowing speech-bubble mascot with two friendly eyes floating at bottom-right above the tab bar. Turkish UI text, legible, minimal. No ads, no hearts/lives, no timers, no leaderboards, no real brand logos.
